R2 (Vera F1). Reading of NV2(c), and applied identically to the slope rules of H2, H3(a) and H3(b):
   if the error is smallest at the largest step h_1 (no truncation-side pair), the row FAILS its slope gate.
   It is never a vacuous pass. "Slope not resolvable by the R reference" requires at least one truncation-side
   pair, with every truncation-side pair failing the resolvability test rho(s_{k+1}) <= e_c(h_k)/30.
